item.description: TRex Bio, a clinical stage biotechnology company focused on precision immunoregulatory medicines derived from tissue regulatory T cell biology, announced it closed an oversubscribed $50 million financing to support clinical and preclinical pipeline development and expand work on its proprietary Deep Biology Platform. item.title: NorthRock Partners Onboards $500 Million Firm Martin & Associates And Tops $11 Billion In AUM
item.description: NorthRock Partners announced that an Illinois-based advisory firm, Martin & Associates, has joined the company, extending NorthRock’s presence in the state and pushing the firm past $11 billion in total assets under management. NorthRock said the team, which previously was affiliated with Ameriprise Financial, is expected to add about $500 million in AUM and represents NorthRock’s first transaction of the year.
